basic_info.description: Dreaming of your own slice of San Francisco charm? Welcome to this beautifully updated single-story home in the heart of the Excelsior, where city living meets comfort and convenience. Just steps from the rolling trails and open space of John McLaren Park, this home invites you in with warmth and ease. Inside, natural light fills every corner. The living, dining, and kitchen areas flow together effortlessly creating a space that feels cozy and connected, perfect for unwinding or gathering with loved ones. Extensively remodeled in 2023, this home blends modern finishes with timeless character. But the true magic happens at the back. Two expansive sliding glass doors wrap the rear corner, opening wide to reveal a rare San Francisco treasure: a spacious backyard retreat. Whether you're enjoying a quiet morning or relaxing in the sun, this outdoor space offers a level of freedom and privacy thats hard to come by in the city. With two comfortable bedrooms, two updated baths, in-home laundry, and a generous 2,596 sq ft lot, this home balances ease and city living. The backyard offers potential for an ADU ideal for extended family, a private guest suite, or added rental income. Dont miss your chance to make this charming San Francisco home yours
